notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 942 K, $\alpha - \beta$ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.667$ kcal/mol. 
1049 K, β - γ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.137$ kcal/mol. 
1408 K, melting point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.185$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 9.169 + 0.630 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.842 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=9.169\times10^{-3}T+0.315\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.842\times10^{2}T^{-1}-3.044$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-942 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = 58.182 + 1.887 \times 10^{-9} \mathrm{T} - 4.067 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 137.550 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 58.182 - 1.887 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 4.067 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 68.775 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 12.427 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
942-1049 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 60.592 - 5.258 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.155 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 50.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 60.592 + 5.258 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.155 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 25.025 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 59.888 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1049-1408 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 58.296 - 4.153 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.155 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 50.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 58.296 + 4.153 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.155 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 25.025 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 50.013 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1408-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 59.603 - 6.633 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.155 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 50.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = 59.603 + 6.633 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.155 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 25.025 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 68.921 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Gronvold (47) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
